2607.01233.title: Measuring the Gap Between Human and LLM Research Ideas
2607.01233.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly used to brainstorm research ideas, but existing evaluations mostly judge individual ideas by novelty, feasibility, or expert preference. We instead ask: how far are current LLM-generated ideas from human researchers? To characterize this gap, we build a large-scale evaluation framework for ideation from high-quality human research papers. For each paper, we reverse-engineer a small set of closely related prior works that likely inspired its core idea. LLMs are then prompted to generate a new idea from the set of paper titles and summaries. We introduce a two-axis research-taste taxonomy to profile each idea by its opportunity pattern and research paradigm, and use it to quantify the divergence between human and LLM ideas. Across idea sets generated by different LLMs, we observe a consistent distributional gap: LLM ideas are disproportionately concentrated around bridge-like opportunities and synthesis methods, whereas the human paper reference distribution spreads more broadly across ways of framing gaps and constructing contributions. This result suggests that strong LLMs can produce a range of reasonable ideas, but that range remains narrower than, and systematically shifted relative to, human research taste.
2607.01233.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 正在被越來越多地用來腦力激盪研究想法，但現有的評估主要是根據新穎性、可行性或專家偏好來評價個別想法。我們則提出另一個問題：當前 LLM 生成的想法與人類研究者的想法有多遠？為了描述這一差距，我們建立了一個大規模的評估框架，以高品質的人類研究論文作為靈感來源。對於每篇論文，我們逆向工程出一小組可能啟發其核心想法的相關先前作品。然後，LLMs 被提示從這組論文標題和摘要中生成一個新想法。我們引入了一個兩軸研究品味分類法，根據每個想法的機會模式和研究範式來描述它，並用它來量化人類和 LLM 想法之間的差異。在不同 LLM 生成的想法集之間，我們觀察到一個一致的分佈差距：LLM 想法不成比例地集中在橋樑式的機會和綜合方法上，而人類論文參考的分佈則更廣泛地涵蓋了框架差距和構建貢獻的方式。這一結果表明，強大的 LLM 可以產生一系列合理的想法，但這一範圍仍然比人類研究品味更窄，且系統性地偏離。
